title: Project
description: A HOTL project under an organization (ADR 0024, ADR 0025): groups one or more repositories with isolated rules, knowledge, optional toolchain images and optional egress allowlists.

project.description: Project identifier, unique within the organization.

version.description: Version of the project record, from 1. Assigned by the review service.

description.description: What this project is and what stack/runtime it targets.

githubOrg.description: Optional GitHub organization override for this project's repos.

rulesRepos.description: Optional dedicated rule/docs repositories for this project, in addition to .hotl/rules/ and docs/adr/ inside project repos.

egress.description: Per-project egress allowlist enforced by agent-egress (ADR 0025).

allowHosts.description: Hostnames (e.g. repo.maven.apache.org) that agent pods for this project may reach over HTTPS CONNECT.
